claims: Walt Disney received 59 Academy Award nominations.
22 of Walt Disney's Academy Awards are competitive.
4 of Walt Disney's Academy Awards are honorary.
Walt Disney received the majority of his awards for Best Animated Short Film.
Walt Disney has the most overall Oscar wins with 26.
Katharine Hepburn has the most acting Oscar wins with 4.
Walt Disney has the most overall Oscar nominations with 59.
Meryl Streep has the most acting Oscar nominations with 21.
Dennis Muren has the most Oscar wins by a living person with 9.
Jack Nicholson, Daniel Day-Lewis, and Walter Brennan each have 3 acting Oscar wins.
Katharine Hepburn is the only performer to win four competitive acting Oscars.
Katharine Hepburn won the Best Actress Oscar for Morning Glory.
Katharine Hepburn won the Best Actress Oscar for Guess Who's Coming to Dinner.
Katharine Hepburn won the Best Actress Oscar for The Lion in Winter.
Katharine Hepburn won the Best Actress Oscar for On Golden Pond.
